name: floor
description: Floor: automatic stop-loss and take-profit for everyday crypto holders on Monad

scripts.contracts:deploy:demo: cd contracts && forge script script/DeployDemo.s.sol --rpc-url monad_testnet --broadcast --gas-estimate-multiplier 115 --verify --verifier sourcify --verifier-url https://sourcify-api-monad.blockvision.org/
scripts.contracts:smoke:testnet: cd contracts && SMOKE_FILL=true forge script script/Smoke.s.sol --rpc-url monad_testnet --broadcast --gas-estimate-multiplier 115
scripts.contracts:deploy:live: cd contracts && forge script script/DeployLive.s.sol --rpc-url monad_mainnet --broadcast --gas-estimate-multiplier 115 --verify --verifier sourcify --verifier-url https://sourcify-api-monad.blockvision.org/
scripts.contracts:smoke:mainnet: cd contracts && forge script script/Smoke.s.sol --rpc-url monad_mainnet --broadcast --gas-estimate-multiplier 115
